plainText:
Volume 9 is the ninth and final volume published by Kurokawa compiling chapters from the of the Pokémon Adventures manga created by Hidenori Kusaka and Satoshi Yamamoto. The chapters in this volume have been collected directly from the magazine publication of Pokémon Adventures.

==Publications==
 
 

==Chapters==
Ghetis se dévoile (« Ghetsis unveils »)
L'union fait la force ! (« Unity makes strength! »)
La légende reprend vie (« The legend revives »)
Mission sauvetage (« Rescue mission »)
Amère victoire (« Bitter victory »)

==Major events==
N's Castle appears from beneath the , and Team Plasma appears.

The Gym Leaders are freed.

Black defeats N.
Black battles with Ghetsis and defeats him.
N sees the error of his ways and bids farewell.
Black is thrown onto Reshiram as it is reverting back into the Light Stone, and subsequently disappears.
Several s escape and go into hiding.
